testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel browsing for a project workspace folder: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/current-project-dialog-source/features/application/project-dialog/project-dialog.feature:74:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel browsing for a project workspace folder ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with `fixtures/cad/project-dialog-native/WizardProject.opj` as its first project ✔ And the user opens Projects from the template chooser, chooses New and advances to the project-file page ✔ And a workspace folder and project file location are displayed ✔ When the user chooses the workspace folder browse control ✔ Then a folder browser opens with a folder tree and a Folder field ✔ And it offers Make New Folder, OK and cancels ✔ When the user selects Documents in the folder tree ✔ Then Documents is selected and its child folders are displayed ✔ And the Folder field displays Documents ✔ When the user chooses Cancel in the folder browser ✔ Then the folder browser closes ✔ And the wizard still displays the previous workspace folder and project file location ✔ When the user cancels the project wizard ✔ Then the Projects dialog is displayed
